name: Paragraph-level Topic Representation Corpus (Chinese)
description: A corpus and benchmark for paragraph-level topic segmentation and outline generation in Chinese texts.
evaluation_method: F1 (for segmentation) and ROUGE / BLEU (for outline generation)
reputation: A niche, language-specific dataset used in Chinese discourse and topic-structure research with moderate recognition in that community but limited global adoption.
notes: Chinese-only dataset; annotation can be subjective (outline/segmentation labels); moderate size (not extremely large); not primarily an LLM benchmark and potential domain/language contamination for models pre-trained on large Chinese corpora.
